_readme: Moderation rules for hosted Dropisode. Checked before any money is spent (prompts, scripts, reference images) and on samples of generated outputs. A rule blocks when OpenAI flags its category (if orFlagged) or the category score reaches the threshold. 'applies': text, image or any. 'when: request_has_image' only applies when the same request also carries an image. Changes need the owner's OK. Categories: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/moderation Owner decision 2026-10-30: block only illegal content for now (sexual content involving minors; sexualising an uploaded photo, which may show a real person). Public figures are switched off while the policy is debated; the name list stays in config/public-figures.json.
